discription: A simple sawtooth wave synth with a low-pass filter and ADSR envelope. It uses a resonant low-pass filter (RLPF) to shape the timbre.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, cutoff=3000, rq=0.5; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.2, 0.7, 0.8, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = Saw.ar(freq); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
